title: The cutoff trap
summary: LLMs recite model IDs, base URLs and API-key header names from training data with the same confidence as a live catalog. The number-one integration failure in this project is recommending last year's cheap model (Haiku 3, gpt-4o, gemini-1.5-pro, grok-2) and last year's auth shape, then burning a full test cycle. Worse: some providers silently remap retired slugs onto a different model and price instead of 404ing.
invariants: A model ID without an observed_as_of date is not a recommendation.
Primary provider docs beat aggregator blogs, which beat model memory.
GET list-models on the live key is the only current catalog for that key.
This sphere is not an attack-surface map and does not document unpublished endpoints or credential theft.
